content:
Hi, I am not sure if someone had premade it, but still sharing here.
I made a symlink mathlib script which puts mathlib globally using symlink, so all versions of mathlib in 1 place(till Lean supports it which i heard it will someday). It can also migrate your current project's mathlib to cache too. Just do mathlib init and that's it.
https://gist.github.com/AnirudhG07/0f924bda41a60bc70d9cb7d8a16ddb14
Hope this will be convenient. I personally reduced around 20GB worth mathlib from this.

Note if you find any bugs(which is possible, since i only tested locally for few repo's i had) please let me know.

Have you seen https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/wiki/Project-setup:-globally-shared-mathlib-installation? It seems the trick in the wiki accomplishes the same, and has been well-tested.

Thanks for sharing!
This has 1 global mathlib as far as i understood, and if separate projects were not upgraded for it, it would be a bit more work, but definitely possible.
Mine just puts all mathlib in different versions in 1 place, so cache can have many mathlib versions, based on which the current project can symlink it.
